notes.title: Rotten Flesh v2.1.5 - Localazation and bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Hope you are all doing well.

As always I wish to thank EACH and everyone of you for your support and for playing the game. All your feedback, suggestions and criticism means so much to me to help me improve more and more daily. 

I have tested localization a bit, it's still in early works but hopefully could get it fully done in the next couple of weeks. For the moment, we have enabled interface localization. That means the main menu, settings, UI, inventory etc will be available in multiple languages other then English.

[b]You can switch the language in the settings menu.[/b]

These are the new added languages in the game for INTERFACE only:
- English
- French
- German
- Spanish
- Japanese
- Korean
- Russian
- Simplified Chinese

Please note this is still in early development so do let me know about any bugs. Alongside that, an additional bug fixes were present in the game.

[list]
[*]     Added multiple languages to the game which you can now change in the settings.
[*]     Updated some UI changes in general, also for the English localization. 
[*]     Fixed an issue with the quality which were getting low-res textures on some areas.
[*]     Fixed more invisible barriers and some issues where the player can walk through walls.
[*]     Fixed a couple of more unaligned textures that could be seen on the map.
[*]     More additional props have been filled up in the map.
[*]     Some jumpscares sounds were improved significantly. 
[*]     Fixed some controller issues, and some bugs that had to do with controller input.
[*]     Fixed the issue where the game restarts at the end.
[*]     Updated some more new sounds and music effects.
[*]     The localization is only for the normal game mode for the moment.
[/list]

Feel free to hop in and chat with me directly if you like on our discord. It's still very small though, but we are improving it daily and have a little nice community there :)

Discord Link: https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK

Let me know if you encounter anymore bugs. Thanks and hope you have a great day all! You are all amazing, for real

notes.title: Rotten Flesh v2.1.2 - Steam Achievements, Bug Fixes and More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Hope you are all doing well, and today I spent a whole Sunday working on Rotten Flesh to try and do something I never achieved in any of my games - Achievements (literally)  

Firstly I wish to thank you so much for your support and for playing the game. I really appreciate each comment, feedback and criticism for the game - as this really helps a solo dev out! Keep them coming.

One of the biggest things this update have to offer is steam achievements! I have been working on it the whole day to try and make them work, and hopefully at last they are. I was getting a couple of messages from you awesome people to add them, so I wanted to try and do it. For now there will be basic ones but will be adding more alongside the road if want! Let me know.

[list]
[*]     Added Steam Achievements after years of failing and that could not get them to work (Yay!)
[*]     Rats can now no longer attack you through lockers, however they can still attack you when you are hiding under the tables since they can get to you through there.
[*]     Fixed some performance issues related to making the game lag on TAB press.
[*]     Added and remapped the pistol icon and the error which was displaying a different gun sometimes.
[*]     Fixed some more issues with walls that you can walk through in the game.
[*]     Fixed a couple of more unaligned textures. 
[*]     Fixed the monster not spawning after save for some reason.
[*]     Fixed some more flickering textures in the map.
[*]     Added some new decals and props around the map to fill it up more.
[*]     Increased lantern's light source for better viability.
[*]     Decreased some jumpscare sounds that were too LOUD.
[*]     Fixed some controller issues where after death you can't use the controller.
[*]     Fixed the issue where the player can fall out of the map randomly. 
[*]     Updated some sounds and effects.
[*]     The enemy's hearing range have been decreased from 150 to 85 in terms of radius range.
[*]     All changes are updated for the two modes.
[/list]

As always I wish to remind you that there is also "NO JUMPSCARE MODE" which removed the LOUD sudden jumpscares in the game only, but leaves the other important and scripted ones. That means the NO JUMPSCARE MODE DO NOT effect the game in general, and you will still get mostly the full experience - just without the loud jumpscares that appear randomly sometimes.

Let me know if you encounter anymore bugs, I really appreciate all your help, your comments, your videos and your feedbacks. Thanks and hope you have a great day all! You are all amazing! :)

notes.title: Rotten Flesh FIRST Update - Major Bug Fixes, Controller Issues v2.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Hope you are all doing well. This is the first update of Rotten Flesh, I wish to thank you so much for your support and for playing the game. I really appreciate each comment, feedback and criticism for the game - as this really helps a solo dev out! 

I am sorry that some of your encountered bugs, and will be doing my best to work around in fixing them and that brings us to the first update of the game, v2.1.1 (first live update, I done SEVERAL fixes already before the release of the game that's why it's 2.1.1) 

[list]
[*] Increased brightness for overall game.
[*]  Fixed a bug issue where keypad door was staying open and missing my favorite part of the game :(
[*]  Reduced lantern's light reduction. Now lanterns won't be needed to re-filled as much.
[*]  Fixed some issues with walls that you can walk through in the game.
[*]  Fixed some unaligned textures.
[*]  Fixed the bug where if the player peaks, then he will get telekinesis and the lantern will float around.
[*]  Fixed the issue with player repeating the same voice-overs at some areas.
[*]  Fixed some flickering textures.
[*]  Fixed the issue where the game does not take you back to the main menu after it ends.
[*]  Increased lantern's light source for better viability.
[*]  Fixed the issue where if you use a controller the graphics settings won't appear.
[*]  Fixed some controller issues where the game freeze with a controller, especially in the main menu. 
[*]  Fixed some other minor bug issues.
[*]  Updated some randomize jumpscares.
[*]  Updated some sound effects.
[*]  Decrease the enemies hearing range to make the game more balanced.
[*]  All changes are updated for the two modes.
[/list]

As always let me know if you encounter anymore bugs, I really appreciate all your help. Thanks and hope you have a great day all!
